HDFC Mutual Fund

HDFC Test Large Cap Fund - Direct Growth

This is an open-ended equity scheme that invests in large cap stocks. The investment objective is to generate long-term capital appreciation from a portfolio of equity investments in large cap companies.

Exit Load

  • No exit load is charged if units are redeemed after 1 year from the date of allotment.
  • An exit load of 1.00% is charged if units are redeemed within 1 year.

Benchmark

The scheme's benchmark is the Nifty 50 Total Return Index.

Riskometer

Investors should understand that their investments will be at high risk and are subject to market risks. Read all scheme related documents carefully before investing.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is the lock-in period for this fund?

A: There is no lock-in period for this scheme. Units can be redeemed at any time after the applicable exit load period has elapsed.

Q: How do I download my capital gains statement?

A: Download the capital gains statement from the AMC website under the Reports section, or from the registrar's website using your folio number.
